title: Settings
subtitle: Language, launch, downloads, appearance and account.

dataFolder.title: Data folder
dataFolder.text: Clients, library and logs live here.

language.title: Language
language.text: The launcher speaks the language you pick here. Server names, map names and file titles stay as their authors wrote them.
language.label: Interface language
language.needsTranslation: This language is not translated yet and shows English.
language.draft: This language is a machine draft and is waiting for a native speaker to check it.

gameFiles.title: Game files
gameFiles.text: JKNet reads the archives in these folders and writes nothing into them. One game is enough; set up the other whenever you like.

launch.title: Launch
launch.label: Extra launch arguments
launch.hint: Appended to every client, exactly as in a shortcut. Example: <0>+set r_fullscreen 0 +set r_mode 4</0>. Double quotes keep a value with a space together.
launch.order: The arguments of a client stand after these, so a client that repeats a <0>+set</0> of the same cvar is the value the game takes.

onboarding.title: First-time setup
onboarding.text: Walks through game files, a client and an account again. Nothing you have set up is removed.

cache.title: Cache
cache.count_one: {{count}} map has a picture, read from the pk3 files you already own. Nothing is downloaded.
cache.count_other: {{count}} maps have a picture, read from the pk3 files you already own. Nothing is downloaded.
cache.lastRebuild: Last rebuild: {{maps}} pictures from {{sources}} files in {{elapsed}}.

jkhub.title: JKHub catalog
jkhub.text: The Browse JKHub tab lists and searches a local copy of the jkhub.org catalog. JKNet keeps that copy current by itself, and these actions are for the times it cannot.
jkhub.rebuildHint: Read every listing page of jkhub.org again. About 150 requests and a minute and a half.
jkhub.categoriesHint: Walk the JKHub category tree again. Takes about twenty requests.
jkhub.cacheText: File pages, listings and the archives JKNet downloaded to install. Clearing them costs nothing but reading the site again.

rest.title: The rest of the settings is not wired up yet
rest.text: The Downloads and Appearance sections arrive together with the features they control.

about.title: About
about.text: JKNet updates itself from GitHub Releases. Every package is signed, and an unsigned one is refused.
about.engineIcons: Engine icons belong to their projects, all released under GPL-2.0:
